definition: To become familiar with something new until it feels normal.
exampleSentence: It may take a few weeks to get used to your new keyboard.

definition: To start a machine or light by pressing a button or switch.
exampleSentence: Please turn on the projector before the presentation starts.

definition: To stop a machine or light by pressing a button or switch.
exampleSentence: Remember to turn off the lights when you leave the classroom.

definition: To enter an account by typing your name and password.
exampleSentence: You need a valid password to log in to the school system.

definition: To leave an account so others cannot use it.
exampleSentence: Always log out of your account when you use a public computer.

definition: To put your name on a list to join a service, class or event.
exampleSentence: You can sign up for the free English course on our website.

definition: To make a copy of your files in case the originals are lost.
exampleSentence: It is a good habit to back up your photos every month.

definition: To look at something because it is interesting.
exampleSentence: You should check out the new cafe that opened near the station.

definition: To write the needed information on a form.
exampleSentence: Please fill out this form and give it to the receptionist.

definition: To search for information in a book or online.
exampleSentence: If you do not know a word, look up its meaning in a dictionary.

definition: To think of an idea, plan or answer.
exampleSentence: Our team needs to come up with a better name for the app.

definition: To use all of something so that none is left.
exampleSentence: Our printer will soon run out of paper, so please order more.

definition: To remember something important when you make a plan or decision.
exampleSentence: Keep in mind that the store closes early on Sundays.

definition: Responsible for controlling a group, task or place.
exampleSentence: Sarah is in charge of the security team at our company.

definition: To take action to solve a problem or handle a task.
exampleSentence: Customer support teams deal with hundreds of complaints every single day.

definition: To need someone or something in order to succeed or exist.
exampleSentence: Many small shops depend on tourists during the summer season.

definition: To have a friendly relationship with someone.
exampleSentence: I get along with all of my colleagues at my new job.

definition: To stop working or doing something for a short time to rest.
exampleSentence: After two hours of coding, it is important to take a break.

definition: To choose what to do after thinking about it.
exampleSentence: We have to make a decision about the new design by Friday.

definition: To do something wrong without meaning to.
exampleSentence: Do not worry if you make a mistake; everyone learns that way.

definition: To look at something quickly.
exampleSentence: Could you have a look at my code and tell me what is wrong?

definition: Done because you wanted to, not by accident.
exampleSentence: I am sure he did not break the window on purpose.

definition: Done by accident, without meaning to.
exampleSentence: I deleted the important file by mistake and had to restore it.

definition: Before a particular time or event.
exampleSentence: You should book your flight tickets in advance to get a cheaper price.

definition: Modern, or having the newest information or version.
exampleSentence: Keep your operating system up to date to stay protected from attacks.

definition: Not working, usually said about a machine.
exampleSentence: The elevator is out of order, so we have to take the stairs.

definition: Because of the thing that was just mentioned.
exampleSentence: It rained heavily all night; as a result, many roads were closed.

definition: Used to add another fact or point.
exampleSentence: The job offers a good salary; in addition, you can work from home.

definition: Together, in the same moment.
exampleSentence: It is hard to listen to music and study at the same time.

definition: Sometimes, but not often or regularly.
exampleSentence: From time to time we visit our old school to see our teachers.

definition: At some time in the future, even if you do not know when.
exampleSentence: If you keep practicing, sooner or later you will speak fluently.

definition: Until now.
exampleSentence: So far, the new system has worked without any serious problems.

definition: Usually, or when thinking about most cases.
exampleSentence: In general, people in this city are friendly and helpful to visitors.

definition: Certainly, without any doubt.
exampleSentence: I do not know for sure when the package will arrive.

definition: To have the skill or chance to do something.
exampleSentence: After this course, you will be able to write simple programs in Python.

definition: To have a skill and do something well.
exampleSentence: You do not have to be good at math to learn programming.

definition: To want to learn more about something or someone.
exampleSentence: Many young people seem to be interested in artificial intelligence today.

definition: To feel fear because of someone or something.
exampleSentence: There is no reason to be afraid of making mistakes when speaking English.

definition: A polite way to say that you want to do something.
exampleSentence: I would like to order a large pizza and two drinks, please.

definition: To tell someone about a fact or a mistake they had not noticed.
exampleSentence: My teacher was kind enough to point out the errors in my essay.
